what.pointsElsewhere: points it at a different source

shared.gone: This is no longer in the workspace.

activity.label: Pipeline activity
activity.title: Deployments
activity.empty: Nothing has deployed in the last hour. Saving a change deploys its author's preview; publishing deploys the app for everyone.
activity.how1: Everyone changes an app in their own working copy.
activity.how2: Each saved change deploys that person's preview. Previews have their own data, so trying a change never touches the published app's data.
activity.how3: Publishing merges it, and the published app is deployed for everyone.

data.notPublished: Not published yet: it's only in working copies so far.
data.databaseText: Part of the app. The published app and every preview each have their own copy, so trying a change never touches the published data.
data.filesText: Keeps files people upload in the app, such as photos and documents.
data.functionsText: Functions run in Fabric. They reach other services as the app itself, not as the person using it.
data.notConnected: Not connected in a published app yet: only in working copies so far.
data.serviceText: Functions reach {{service}} as the app itself, so the app needs access to it there.

diff.noPreview: No preview for this file (it’s binary or very large).
diff.fileTruncated: The rest of this file’s changes aren’t shown here.
diff.none: No changes compared with the published app yet.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.message: The app's folder is removed from the workspace for everyone.
remove.alsoFabric: Also delete its published app and previews in Fabric, with their data

fabric.prodText: The pipeline deploys each app here when changes are published. Everyone on the team uses these.
fabric.previewText: The pipeline deploys everyone’s personal previews here, one per person and app, so work in progress never touches the published apps or their data.

app.notPublished: Not published yet: it’s published for everyone the first time someone publishes it.
app.nobody: Nobody is changing this app right now.

pub.dataLoss: The last publish stopped because it would delete data. Publish again from the app and confirm to allow it.

copy.deploying: The pipeline is deploying the latest save
copy.localMine: Runs on your computer. Your preview deploys when you publish.
copy.localTheirs: Runs on {{author}}’s computer. Their preview deploys when they publish.
copy.gone: This working copy was published or discarded.

view.emptyText: Create the first app in this workspace; it shows up here with everyone's work on it.

workspace.label: Workspace
workspace.verifyStep: Check that the pipeline can reach Fabric

members.title: People
members.invitedNotice: Invited {{name}}. They can accept from Fabricator's Home or on GitHub.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.maintainer: GitHub only lets admins of {{repo}} add or remove people, and you have the Maintain role. Ask one of its admins to add your teammates with the Write role.
invite.emailHint: Lets them open previews and published apps in Fabric.

access.title: Who can open the apps
access.intro: People with access to the workspace's Fabric workspaces can sign in to its previews and published apps. Invite a teammate with their work email to add them.
access.remove: Remove their access to the apps
access.none: Nobody yet besides the workspace's admins.
access.revoked: {{name}} can no longer open the team's apps.

settings.accountInUse: Fabricator works on this workspace as this account.
settings.accountLater: Fabricator remembers the account once it reads the workspace.
settings.accountSaved: Fabricator now works on this workspace as {{login}}.
settings.reviewHint: A teammate approves each change before it's published.
settings.reviewHintEnforced: A teammate approves each change before it's published. Where GitHub doesn’t protect main, Fabricator enforces this.
settings.runnerFailed: Could not check where the pipeline runs.
settings.runnerSaved: Pipeline runs that start from now on use these runners.
settings.leaveText: Leaving removes the workspace from this computer. Published apps and work saved to GitHub stay.
settings.leaveTextMaintainer: Leaving removes the workspace from this computer. Published apps and work saved to GitHub stay. Deleting the workspace archives its repository, which GitHub only lets its admins do.

confirm.removeMemberText: They lose access to the repository, and to the team's apps in Fabric if you gave it to them from this computer. Their unpublished changes stay on GitHub.
confirm.revokeText: They can no longer open the team's published apps or previews in Fabric.
confirm.leaveText: The workspace and its apps are removed from this computer. Nothing changes for your teammates.
confirm.deleteText: Fabricator deletes the deploy identities it created, archives the GitHub repository (an owner can restore it on GitHub), and removes the workspace from this computer.
confirm.deleteFabric: Also delete both Fabric workspaces and every app in them, with their data
